glosses: cinema; movie theater (building where films are shown to an audience)
cinema (the art or industry of making films)
cinema (films from a particular place or of a particular style as a group)

examples.en: Do you want to go to the movies?

examples.text: Posso ir ao cinema com vocês?
examples.en: Can I go to the movies with you?
There are a number of movie theaters in this city.
Yesterday, they went to the movies.
Are there any movie theaters near here?
